evaluation_protocol.primary: D predicted + K calibrated + pose predicted; one GT median D scale per context applied to D and translation; canonical first-camera gauge; no global Sim3/ICP
evaluation_protocol.secondary: one global point Sim3 on same valid correspondences; camera ATE/RPE uses a separate camera-center Sim3
evaluation_protocol.RPE_interval: consecutive selected frames, delta=1 in sample positions; original-frame gaps vary with N
evaluation_protocol.surfaces: CD mean unsquared bidirectional nearest-neighbour distances / 2; NC native normal consistency; no ICP
evaluation_protocol.surface_availability: BEST/FINAL validation all five N; four models N50 all sequences; unavailable metrics remain N/D
evaluation_protocol.macro: equal sequence weights, splits separate; missing metric yields N/D rather than dropping sequences
evaluation_protocol.N1_camera: ATE/RPE and pairwise pose undefined, not zero
evaluation_protocol.context_caveat: N changes selected frames and evaluated support, not a causal fixed-support capacity threshold

selection_rule.support: validation only; both fixed N50 windows; equal sequence weights
selection_rule.numerical_tolerance: max(1e-8, 1e-6 * abs(reference)); numerical only, not an allowed quality regression
selection_rule.decision: Replace FINAL only if all macro metrics are non-worse, at least one improves, and per-sequence guards pass. Otherwise retain FINAL by continuity and report tradeoffs; never claim universal dominance.
selection_rule.heldout_access: BEST800 reserved inference is forbidden until baseline_selection.json is frozen
selection_rule.smaller_N: diagnostic, not used to change the primary decision
selection_rule.secondary_Sim3: diagnostic only, not optimized for checkpoint selection
